title: Westbrook High Rising
author: Vesper Whitlock
blurb: Jonah Underhill, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
